transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called this case conference under our standard pre-filing practice. As you all know, a former sales executive left last week and joined a direct competitor. We believe confidential customer information may have been used after the departure, and we may be looking at a preliminary-injunction hearing within three weeks. Our draft filing currently seeks broad relief covering customer information, pricing materials, and source-code documentation. Before I can make any filing decision, I need each of you to report any material issues in your respective areas. Let's start with employment counsel -- are there any material issues on the employment side I need to be aware of?
